attributes.name: Druva - Backup Security Posture Degradation
attributes.description: Detects administrative actions that weaken critical backup/recovery controls such as backup enablement, retention, SafeMode, immutability, or Data Lock.
author: Druva
tags: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience

meta.pack: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience
meta.customer_usecase: Detects administrative actions that weaken critical backup/recovery controls such as backup enablement, retention, SafeMode, immutability, or Data Lock.

attributes.query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| EVAL event_text = TO_LOWER(
    COALESCE(
      TO_STRING(message),
      TO_STRING(message),
      TO_STRING(druva.event_type),
      ""
    )
  )

| EVAL degradation = CASE(
    event_text LIKE "*backup*disabled*",
      "Backup disabled",

    event_text LIKE "*backup*paused*",
      "Backup paused",

    event_text LIKE "*retention*reduced*",
      "Retention reduced",

    event_text LIKE "*safemode*disabled*",
      "SafeMode disabled",

    event_text LIKE "*safe mode*disabled*",
      "SafeMode disabled",

    event_text LIKE "*immutability*disabled*",
      "Immutability disabled",

    event_text LIKE "*data lock*disabled*",
      "Data Lock disabled",

    event_text LIKE "*backup*deleted*",
      "Backup deleted",

    "none"
  )

| WHERE degradation != "none"

| EVAL event_time =
    @timestamp

| EVAL actor = COALESCE(
    TO_STRING(user.id),
    TO_STRING(user.name)
  )

| EVAL resource = COALESCE(
    TO_STRING(druva.resource.name),
    TO_STRING(druva.profile.name),
    TO_STRING(druva.resource.name)
  )
